A '''shafar''' was one of the minor [[Priest/Legends|priests]] in the [[Ni'Shaw-Dak Ministry|Ni'Shaw-Dak]] religion, being under the [[Al'ma'den]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

1,728 shafars were scattered through all the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="AIR" />
